name: netprobe
description: Operator-driven reachability testing against devices this appliance already knows: ping to answer 'is it there and how well', traceroute to answer 'where does the path break'. ACTIVE, unlike the lookup tool — it emits packets — so the target space is constrained rather than the caller: a probe may only be aimed at a host already in the LAN inventory or already enrolled as an approved agent, never an arbitrary address. Deliberately a separate module from lookup so that module's read-only property stays literally true. Port scanning and packet capture are NOT included and are held pending an authorization layer.
